title: Phipps Garden Apartments from 39th Avenue
description: A long brick apartment block with green-painted window frames, patterned brickwork panels and a stepped roofline. Raised lettering above the recessed central doorway reads PHIPPS GARDEN APARTMENTS. Bare plane trees, traffic signals and a 39 AV street sign stand at the curb under an overcast winter sky.
author: Jim.henderson
